tweets.text:
It’s great that there’s been so much attention on H-1B visas, but equal focus should be given to another real job-killer for new American grads — the OPT program. There are no caps, and approvals keep growing: nearly 400,000 work permits were issued in 2024 alone!

Congress never created the OPT program — it was made entirely through administrative regulation. That means the Trump administration could end it, or at least reverse Obama’s STEM 3-year work permit rule back to just one year.
